```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Run Claude Code for issue triage
        id: claude
        env:
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          prompt=$(printf '%s' "You are an issue triage assistant. Analyze the following issue and suggest labels to apply. Return a JSON object with a \"labels\" field containing an array of label names. Do not include any other text.\n\nIssue title: %s\nIssue body:\n%s\n\nOutput format:\n{\n  \"labels\": [\"label1\", \"label2\"]\n}" "$ISSUE_TITLE" "$ISSUE_BODY")
          prompt_escaped=$(printf '%q' "$prompt")
          output=$(docker run --rm -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" anthropic/claude-code:latest run --model claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 --temperature 0 --max_output_tokens 200 --prompt "$prompt_escaped")
          echo "output=$output" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Parse labels
        id: parse
        run: |
          labels=$(echo "${{ steps.claude.outputs.output }}" | jq -r '.labels | join(" ")')
          echo "labels=$labels" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Apply labels
        if: steps.parse.outputs.labels != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const labels = '${{ steps.parse.outputs.labels }}'.split(' ');
            const issueNumber = ${{ github.event.issue.number }};
            await github.issues.addLabels({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber,
              labels
            });
```
